provider: Built-in image generation and deterministic SVG diagrams
note: Pictures support interpretation of the editable lesson text; they are not standalone evidence or answer keys. Numerical records and named practice stories are fictional. Read each sort in its stated context. Educator review is pending.

sources.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: square AlloPack lesson illustration. A single empty multipurpose community room with one clear central floor area, stackable chairs along one wall, a folded table and a sunlit window. Handmade miniature assembled from layered cardboard and colored paper, visibly crafted, not photorealistic. No clocks, labels or people. Text-free: no writing, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Focus on the stated lesson objects; do not add students, decorative badges, explanatory arrows or captions. Keep the subject complete and easy to identify at small size.
sources.alt: A crafted-paper community room has one open floor area with folded furniture along the wall.
sources.caption: The fictional booking task offers one room for one hour. Four groups want that same slot; the activity’s stated constraint makes a choice necessary.

sources.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: square AlloPack lesson illustration. A varied group of musical instruments ready for a youth rehearsal: a hand drum, acoustic guitar, saxophone on a stand, keyboard on a low stand and a violin in an open case. No performers. Handmade miniature cardboard and colored paper sculpture, warm understated colors, cream background, clearly separated instruments, no text, no musical notation. Text-free: no writing, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Focus on the stated lesson objects; do not add students, decorative badges, explanatory arrows or captions. Keep the subject complete and easy to identify at small size.
sources.alt: Crafted-paper instruments include a drum, guitar, saxophone, keyboard and violin.
sources.caption: Band rehearsal is one of four competing uses of the community room. Rank its expected benefits and future costs alongside the other feasible uses.

assets.prompt: Text-free instructional diagram: A taller teal option stands beside a shorter gold option, with an arrow toward the gold option.

assets.caption: Once options are ranked, the gold runner-up represents the next-best feasible alternative. Opportunity cost is the value of that forgone option, not the sum of every rejected option.

assets.caption: A benefit is an expected gain. Compare benefits fairly, including those not measured in money; a checkmark does not guarantee a good outcome.

assets.prompt: Text-free instructional diagram: A crossed-out gray past-cost card sits left of a dividing line, with a forward arrow on the right.

assets.caption: Only unrecoverable past spending or time is sunk. Future use, resale value, skills and remaining costs still matter. The divider separates past expenditure from the next decision.

assets.alt: Blue airflow lines pass above two green hills.
assets.caption: The card assumes ample clean ambient air for the stated small activity at that place and time. It does not claim all clean air or all air access is unlimited.
